```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load packages
```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

## Read data
```{r Data}
fixed <- read_csv("sar_fixed_infrastructure_202511.csv")

aoi <- st_read("shapefiles/aoi.shp") |> 
  select(geometry)
```

## Subset data to wind infra arouna aoi
```{r Subset}
wind <- fixed |> 
  filter(label == c("noise", "wind", "unknown"))

wind_aoi <- fixed |> 
  filter(label == c("noise", "wind", "unknown")) |> 
  filter(between(lon, -71.45, -70.7)) |> 
  filter(between(lat, 40.9, 41.4))
```
